header.title: A war room, redacted
header.sub: The six disciplines a partnership brief runs through. The structure is shown so you can see the rigor. The specific reads are blacked out, and the method is withheld.

p: The first discipline sets a one-sentence posture, reads the register and intent, lists the intel that matters most, and flags the landmines. What you see below is the shape. The specific reads are redacted, because in a real brief they are about the counterpart.

p: Before the meeting, the read is written down as a falsifiable receipt, so it can be scored afterward instead of rationalized. The fields below are the format. The values are redacted.

Every load-bearing claim is checked against external evidence by an independent skeptic before it is trusted. Each ends up GROUNDED, INFERENCE, or STRUCK. The routing, the operators, and the scoring are the core method and are withheld.

blocks.note: Rulings shown; the adjudication engine is withheld.

p: After the meeting, the receipt is scored against reality and each belief is updated with two numbers: confidence (how likely it is true) and conviction (how settled that is). The format is shown; the reads are redacted.

blocks.note: One row left illustrative so the confidence-by-conviction format is visible; the rest redacted.

blocks.intro: How a single read moves across touches. Illustrative, not a real belief.
blocks.close: The point is the shape: resolution climbs and the read corrects itself on the record. The underlying series and the kinematics are computed, not drawn by hand, but the method behind them is withheld.

p: The opportunity is scored on a measured manifold, run through an adversarial gauntlet, and pre-mortemed against the counterpart's real objections along the critical path. This tab is where most of the proprietary machinery lives.

The manifold math, the gauntlet operators (ruin, adversary, constitutional), and the pre-mortem scoring are the core IP and are withheld here. What crosses is only that they exist and what they produce.

The whole read is translated into the counterpart's own register and stress-tested to survive their scrutiny. The mapping shape is shown with one generic line; the full translation and the proofing matrix are withheld.

rows: a decision receipt with the same shape

p: The operators, the scoring, the manifold math, the gauntlet, and the exact prompts are the product, and they are withheld by construction. This sample is the shape of the output, not the machine that makes it. That is the honest line: enough to see the rigor, not enough to rebuild it.
